{{short description|none}} {{for|related races|2026 United States House of Representatives elections}} {{Distinguish|2026 Utah House of Representatives election}} {{current election|date=November 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=February 2025}} {{use American English|date=February 2025}} {{Infobox election | election_name = 2026 United States House of Representatives elections in Utah | country = Utah | type = legislative | ongoing = yes | previous_election = 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Utah | previous_year = 2024 | next_election = 2028 United States House of Representatives elections in Utah | next_year = 2028 | seats_for_election = All 4 Utah seats to the [[United States House of Representatives]] | election_date = November 3, 2026 | party1 = Republican Party (United States) | last_election1 = 4 | seats1 = 0 | party2 = Democratic Party (United States) | last_election2 = 0 | seats2 = 0 }} {{ElectionsUT}} The '''2026 United States House of Representatives elections in Utah''' are currently being held on November 3, 2026, to elect the four [[U.S. representative]]s from the [[U.S. state|State]] of [[Utah]], one from all four of the state's [[Utah's congressional districts|congressional districts]]. The elections will coincide with the [[2026 United States House of Representatives elections|other elections]] to the House of Representatives, [[2026 United States Senate elections|elections]] to the [[United States Senate]], and various [[2026 United States elections|state and local elections]]. The primary elections took place on June 23, 2026.{{Cite web|date=May 9, 2025 |title=2026 State Primary Election Dates |url=https://www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/2026-state-primary-election-dates|website= NCSL |access-date=5 August 2025}} {{Horizontal TOC|nonum=yes|limit=2}} == Background == [[File:Utah Congressional Districts, 120th Congress.svg|thumb|250px|Map of Utah's congressional districts as ordered by the Third District Court of Utah on November 10, 2025 and will be used starting at the 2026 House elections.{{Cite news |last=Schoenbaum |first=Hannah |date=November 11, 2025 |title=Judge adopts Utah congressional map creating a Democratic-leaning district for 2026 |url=https://apnews.com/article/utah-redistricting-congressional-map-democrats-a443a6584fad0adeeb5eadcc336a4390 |access-date=November 14, 2025 |work=[[Associated Press]]}}
{{maplink|from=Utah's 1st congressional district (2027–).map|from2=Utah's 2nd congressional district (2027–).map|from3=Utah's 3rd congressional district (2027–).map|from4=Utah's 4th congressional district (2027–).map|text=Interactive map version}} ]] The [[Utah Supreme Court]] ruled in July 2024 that the [[Utah State Legislature|state legislature]] had overstepped their constitutional authority when it repealed [[2018 Utah Proposition 4|Proposition 4]] in 2020 (and subsequently drew congressional districts that heavily favored Republican candidates).{{Cite news |last=Wines |first=Michael |date=2024-07-11 |title=Utah's Gerrymandered House Map Ignored Voters' Will, State Supreme Court Says |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2024/07/11/us/utah-supreme-court-gerrymandering.html |access-date=2025-04-06 |work=The New York Times |language=en-US |issn=0362-4331}} [[League of Women Voters v. Utah State Legislature|The case]] was remanded to the district court to determine a final remedy. The decision was decided on August 25, 2025, ordering the new Utah congressional map be redrawn within 30 days.{{Cite web |last=McKellar |first=Katie |date=2025-02-01 |title=Will Utah get new congressional maps? Judge hears oral arguments in Utah redistricting case • Utah News Dispatch |url=https://utahnewsdispatch.com/2025/01/31/will-utah-get-new-congressional-maps-judge-hears-oral-arguments-in-utah-redistricting-case/ |access-date=2025-04-05 |website=Utah News Dispatch |language=en-US}}{{Cite web |last=Aerts |first=Lindsay |date=April 1, 2025 |title=Judge over gerrymandering case against Utah legislature asks for clarification over tossing maps |url=https://www.abc4.com/news/politics/inside-utah-politics/judge-over-gerrymandering-case-against-utah-legislature-asks-for-clarification-over-tossing-maps/ |access-date=April 5, 2025 |website=[[KTVX|ABC 4 Utah]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250910102610/https://www.abc4.com/news/politics/inside-utah-politics/judge-over-gerrymandering-case-against-utah-legislature-asks-for-clarification-over-tossing-maps/ |archive-date=September 10, 2025 |url-status=dead}}{{Cite web |date=2025-08-26 |title=Judge rules Utah's congressional map must be redrawn for the 2026 elections |url=https://apnews.com/article/utah-redistricting-congressional-map-gerrymandering-a6722505b8e76eda5c73fc346eadd9aa |access-date=2025-08-26 |website=AP News |language=en}} Utah's state legislature passed a new map on October 11, 2025, which created two competitive seats leaning slightly Republican.
